description: BOSTON - Thursday, April 30, 2026 - This Wednesday, the Massachusetts House of Representatives passed H.5500, the Fiscal Year 2027 (FY27) budget. Funded at $63.41 billion, the House’s FY27 budget addresses the critical needs of families and residents across the Commonwealth while dedicating funding to making our communities and state more affordable, livable, and equitable.
